lines.text: Hi, thanks for joining! I'm the Notula demo. Let's pretend we're planning the launch of a new mobile app.
While we talk, Notula transcribes the call on your computer. Try typing a few notes as we go.
First topic: the launch date. We're aiming for Tuesday, March 3, with a beta for 200 users a week before.
The beta goes out through TestFlight, and the sign-up form is already live on the website.
Second topic: the budget. Marketing has 12,000 dollars for launch week, mostly for social ads.
We agreed to skip the paid influencer campaign for now and revisit it after the first month.
Third topic: risks. The payment screen still fails on older Android phones, so that needs a fix first.
Ana owns that bug, and she'll share an update by Friday.
One open question: do we launch in Portugal and Brazil on the same day? Let's decide next week.
On my side, I will write the launch announcement and send it to you for review by Thursday.
And could you book a thirty-minute check-in with the design team for Monday?
Great. That covers the plan: date, budget, risks and who does what.
When the meeting ends, Notula combines your notes with the transcript into clear, organised notes.
Anything you typed stays yours, and the AI fills in the details around it.
You can also chat with your notes afterwards, or pick a template to shape them.
That's it for the demo. Click stop whenever you're ready and watch your notes come together. Bye!
